name: Automotive UDS Diagnostics & CAN Bus Security Analyzer
description: Passive, read-only diagnostic security analyzer for Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS ISO 14229) and CAN bus log captures. Evaluates SecurityAccess (0x27) seed-key randomness, unprotected ECU flashing services, and diagnostic session escalation without physical vehicle writes.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

offline_only.description: Safety gate: enforce strictly offline read-only analysis of recorded PCAP/CAN log traces

audit_security_access_entropy.description: Evaluate Shannon entropy and static seed generation in UDS Service 0x27 exchanges
